description.value: Timberline Lodges is a sprawling 168-suite condo complex at Fernie Alpine Resort, developed across six buildings between 1989 and 2008 and managed by Fernie Lodging Company. Located on Timberline Crescent at the ski resort base, it places guests within easy reach of Fernie's celebrated mountain bike trail network and the lively historic downtown. The property offers shared resort-style facilities including a heated outdoor pool, six hot tubs, sauna, games room, and fitness room spread across the buildings.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Fernie Lodging Company website confirms Timberline Lodges is an active, multi-building vacation rental complex (168 suites across 6 buildings) at Fernie Alpine Resort. Juniper building units (#611–#619) explicitly list 'Bike Storage' as a per-unit amenity, confirming secure bike storage exists on-site; no other buildings mention it. OSM tags contain no phone, address, or website field, so contact_confirmed values are all null; the address and phone are taken from the website's contact pages.
concerns: OSM name is 'Timberline Lodge' (singular) but the property consistently uses 'Timberline Lodges' (plural) on its website.
OSM tags the property as tourism=hotel but it is a self-catered condo/vacation rental complex, not a traditional hotel.
Bike storage is explicitly listed only for Juniper building units; availability in the other five buildings (Spruce, Aspen, King Fir, Balsam, Pine) is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly bookable vacation rental complex at Fernie Alpine Resort with confirmed bike storage in at least one building; a real, operating accommodation well-suited to cycling tourists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Phone 1-250-423-6878 is the Timberline Lodges Front Desk line specifically; 1-800-667-9911 is the general Fernie Lodging Company toll-free reservations number.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: Juniper building units (#611, #612, #613, #616, #618, #619) each explicitly list 'Bike Storage' as an amenity; not confirmed for Spruce, Aspen, King Fir, or Balsam buildings

wow_evidence: heated outdoor pool, six hot tubs, sauna... Juniper building units explicitly list 'Bike Storage'
